tests.name: Same evidence and same rubric
tests.expected_result: Repeated scoring using the same rubric should produce the same recorded scores.

tests.name: Different scores require a review flag
tests.expected_result: The disagreement should be detectable and sent for review according to the configured policy.

tests.name: Missing criterion score
tests.expected_result: The assessment must be marked incomplete; a missing score must not silently become zero or a pass.

tests.name: Score below permitted range
tests.expected_result: Reject the score and display a validation error.

tests.name: Score above permitted range
tests.expected_result: Reject the score and display a validation error.

tests.name: Unsafe action identified

input.scenario: Candidate proposes touching a person who may still be in contact with an electrical source.

tests.expected_result: Flag the unsafe response for assessor review; do not let an aggregate score automatically override a safety concern.

tests.name: Unverified task-to-PC mapping
tests.expected_result: Keep the mapping provisional and prevent it from being presented as an approved official mapping.

tests.name: Evidence is missing
tests.expected_result: Flag the record as incomplete or requiring review according to the configured assessment policy.

tests.name: Audit trail records a score change
tests.expected_result: Record the original score, updated score, change time, responsible user and reason where supported by the application.

tests.name: Offline assessment sync
tests.expected_result: The application should sync the record without silently duplicating or overwriting assessment data.

tests.name: Weighted score calculation
tests.expected_result: Calculate the weighted score correctly. Do not infer a qualification pass from this percentage.

tests.name: Draft assessment cannot claim certification
tests.expected_result: Identify the assessment as draft or provisional and do not generate an approved certification outcome.
